why: A read can be continued and a result is carried up to the head's budget. The device's declarations are unchanged (files.read already says 'pass offset to continue'; results.get and results.list were already registered), so the device request is unchanged: test_e1_request_ceiling measures the same tools and wire bytes as rb-main. The hosted daemon registers the device's results.get and results.list; its files.read declaration is unchanged (PC-0118 was withdrawn after the v5.2.0 table: the longer description moved Haiku's file formatting in tool-chain).
